Name: Cuter Prismatic Shirts
Author: Barbiest
Description:
This is a little mod that changes the appearance of 2 prismatic shirts (the one with white sleeves and the one with black sleeves). It requires content patcher and it should be compatible with most any other clothing mod! It should successfully override *only* those two shirts when installed alongside other clothing mods, including ones that edit the whole shirts tilesheet.

What I plan to add to this mod in the future:
-the other two prismatic shirts
-the two prismatic hats 
-either as an addition to this mod or as a new mod, i have a lot of original shirts and edits I'd like to publish! (will probably be able to publish the original ones sooner, as I'll need to get asset use permission first for the edits)

Anyone has permission from me to convert this to a json assets mod if you know how, as long as you credit me!

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
just unzip the file and drop it into your mods folder :--) can be uninstalled at any time by removing it from the mods folder
